biggest_catch: Bonus amount is randomly selected (£20-£100 personal) and not guaranteed; your friend must invest at least £100 via your link.
catches: Bonus is a randomly selected investment bonus of £20-£200 each for Personal (ISA, GIA or SIPP) referrals per Referral Program Terms V1.4 (active 16/03/2026; from 1 May 2026); Business referrals £100-£400. Approx US$27-US$267 (personal) at ~1.3336 GBP/USD observed from Xe on 2026-09-23
Bonus amounts are selected at random at the point of claiming - the exact amount is not guaranteed and is only revealed on claim
Friend must be a new customer, sign up via your unique referral link, and invest at least £100; cannot be applied retroactively
Referrer must have invested at least £100 of their own money before making referrals; first 25 referrals only
Bonus must remain invested for at least 12 months before withdrawal; withdrawing early lets InvestEngine reclaim the bonus

c1.evidence: InvestEngine (investengine.com) - UK FCA-regulated ETF investment platform (ISA, GIA, SIPP, Business accounts). Official referral scheme help page and terms-incentives page on investengine.com fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official: 'You and your friend could each receive a bonus of £20 to £100' for Personal Account referrals; '£100 to £200 each' for Business Accounts. Terms: 'any individual whose Referee completes registration and funds their ISA, GIA or SIPP Account with InvestEngine will qualify for up to £200 in Referral Funding for both the Referrer and Referee.' Friend must invest at least £100.

c3.evidence: Concretely conditional: refer friend via link, friend invests £100+, both claim bonus.

c4.evidence: No fee to join or refer. Not pay-to-play.

notes: G54 brokerage wave. Referral-bonus route with official current terms V1.4; bonus randomly selected so recorded as range £20-£200 (approx. US$27-US$267 at ~1.3336).

steps: Open an InvestEngine account and invest at least £100 of your own money
Get your unique referral link from the Referrals section
Share it with a friend; when they sign up via your link and invest £100+, you both claim a randomly selected £20-£200 bonus
timing: Ongoing referral scheme; bonus claimed after friend's qualifying investment.
maximize: Official: £20-£200 investment bonus per side, claimed after the friend's qualifying £100+ investment. Fastest path: refer a friend ready to invest £100 immediately. Blocker: payout gated on the friend's timing; no published credit bound.
